csv_project_name: Design Services for Pulpit Harbor Waterfront Facility
csv_agency: Town of North Haven Municipal Office
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of North Haven is seeking proposals from qualified engineering firms to provide professional engineering, design, technical analysis, and public engagement services for the planning and design of a new climate-resilient municipal working waterfront facility. The selected consultant shall conduct the following activities: 1. Plan and participate in project kickoff meeting with Town Staff and relevant, local stakeholders; 2. Conduct site assessments and data collection necessary for 30% design completion; 3. Assist with stakeholder and public engagement; 4. Develop 2 3 conceptual design alternatives; 5. Conduct sea level rise, storm surge, and coastal flooding analyses; 6. Prepare refined design concepts based on stakeholder feedback and financial feasibility; 7. Develop preliminary cost estimates; 8. Prepare a final report with recommendations and implementation and funding strategies
